project_info.theme: High-information food calorie and macro system

main_subject.detail: A grid of four top-down white plates shows salmon grain bowl, chocolate-filled pastry, pizza slice, and smoothie bowl, each with an oversized orange-ring total-calories bubble.
main_subject.style: Apple UI meets National Geographic food science, with crisp food photography and precise black technical connectors

composition_elements.type: Four food modules with nutrition diagrams
composition_elements.text: TOTAL CALORIES; 850 kcal; 350 kcal; 550 kcal; PROTEIN; CARBS; FATS; OMEGA-3 FATTY ACIDS; SALMON; VEGETABLES; QUINOA & RICE; FLOUR; SUGAR & COCOA; FAT & OIL; CRUST; CHEESE/SAUCE; TOPPINGS; SMOOTHIE BASE; FRUIT TOPPINGS; GRANOLA & SEEDS
items: Four quadrants: salmon bowl, chocolate pastry, pizza slice, and fruit smoothie bowl on white plates.
Each top section: large round gray-and-orange calorie bubble, intentionally dominant at thumbnail size.
Left of each plate: stacked colored protein, carbs, and fats percentage bars with gram labels.
Right of each plate: three circular ingredient-composition icons joined by dotted black connectors.
Bottom of each module: preparation/time/origin/source/aging data strip with small pictograms.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: White seamless field, crisp food texture, controlled plate shadow, extremely readable modular data hierarchy

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal food flat-lay with precision vector infographic overlay

assets.name: nutrition data
assets.source: verified nutritional database or recipe calculation
assets.usage: Do not reproduce shown calorie or macro values without current factual validation.

prompt_instructions: Attach food references and verified nutrition data for every card.
Use exactly one accent color for the calorie bubble; retain monochrome UI elsewhere.
Add final numerical labels in a layout tool after nutrition review.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-clean top-down (90° flat lay) infographic composition. A perfectly centered white ceramic plate sits on a seamless light background. On the plate: [FOOD], shown in a precise cross-section or layered cutaway, revealing internal ingredients, textures, and structure with extreme clarity. PRIMARY FOCAL POINT (HERO ELEMENT): Above the plate, occupying a large portion of the upper canvas, place an oversized floating infographic bubble displaying: TOTAL CALORIES [XXXX kcal] The calorie bubble is significantly larger than any other element, instantly readable at thumbnail size. Design it with strong visual contrast: bold sans-serif typography, thick outline or semi-transparent glassmorphism, subtle glow or drop shadow, and clean UI styling. This is the first thing the eye sees. SECONDARY ELEMENTS: Surrounding the plate, fill the remaining space with a dense, high-information infographic system: – Nutritional breakdown charts (protein, carbs, fats) – Ingredient percentage bars and rings – Cooking or preparation temperatures and times – Origin, aging, or production icons – Measurement scales, micro-diagrams, data badges. Use thin vector connectors, dotted lines, arrows, pictograms, and radial charts clearly linking data to specific food components. Visual hierarchy rules: Calorie bubble = dominant. Plate + food = secondary anchor. Surrounding data = tertiary but dense and readable. Design language: premium editorial infographic, Apple UI × National Geographic food science, extremely clean, structured, and modern. Color palette: natural food colors, monochrome infographic UI, one accent color reserved exclusively for the calorie bubble. Lighting: soft studio lighting, zero clutter, flat background for maximum contrast. Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: unverified calorie claims, weak hierarchy, oversized food, cluttered data lines, unreadable macros, poor plate geometry, low resolution, watermark, signature
